name: system-info
description: Provides system information tools including disk usage, process monitoring, and port connectivity checks
author: patrice

tools.name: disk_usage
tools.description: Execute 'df -h' and parse the output to return structured JSON containing mount point, size, used, available, and percentage used for each filesystem

tools.name: top_processes
tools.description: Execute 'ps aux --sort=-%mem' to return the top N memory-consuming processes with details including PID, name, CPU%, memory%, and the full command

count.description: Number of top processes to return (default: 5)

tools.name: port_check
tools.description: Check connectivity to a host and port using Bun.connect, returning reachability status and response time in milliseconds

host.description: Hostname or IP address to check
